mainEntity.name: Which island should I start with if it's my first time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paros. It has the best balance of food, beaches, hotels, and ease, and it connects easily to almost everything else on the matrix.
Yes, for two or three nights, in the right hotel, outside July and August. The caldera is genuinely one of the great sights in the Mediterranean. The mistake is staying a week.

mainEntity.name: How many islands in two weeks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three, comfortably. Four if the transfers are private and you're willing to move at pace. Five is a specific kind of trip and needs to be built that way from the start.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to rent a car?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Milos, Serifos, Tinos, Naxos and Crete, yes. On Folegandros, Sifnos and Santorini you can manage without. On Mykonos and Paros it depends entirely on the hotel.

mainEntity.name: Can you book these hotels for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — that's the job. I have direct relationships with most of the properties on this page, which usually means an upgrade, breakfast, or a credit that isn't available booking direct.
